title: Error Log: the inline pill's 'Undo' beside a re-shown question permanently deletes an older entry, notes and all, with no confirm or Undo
detail: Log a mistake from an exam self-mark (or a quiz miss), then later write 'What went wrong' / 'Rule for next time' and tags on it in the hub. Come back to the same question and reveal the mark scheme: the pill finds the existing open entry by its dedupeKey and draws '✓ Logged · Tag reason' + 'Undo'. One tap on Undo deletes the whole entry, including the user's written notes and tags. No confirm, no toast, no way back; the hub's own Delete (inside Edit) at least offers an Undo toast. Measured on Sample, CS 4.2.1.2 exam Q1: entry err_5jpnot0s73 with wrongNote/ruleNote/mistakeTypes set; after Undo it is gone from state.errorLog.items, #toast is empty and the pill is back to '+ Log mistake'. Reproduced twice.
rootCause: js/core/errorlog.js:176 adopts ANY open entry with the same dedupeKey as the pill's own 'entry', and the Undo button at js/core/errorlog.js:195-196 calls remove(entry.id) unconditionally, so 'Undo' acts on an entry this pill never created
evidence: /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS-519/audit-evidence/2026-12/shots/study-core/topic-cs42112-exam-reveal-mac-sample.png; eval: KOS.errorLog.update(id,{wrongNote,ruleNote,mistakeTypes}) → reopen exam tab → Reveal → click [data-ui~=quiz.log-undo] → entry DELETED, toast ''
fix: Offer Undo only for an entry this pill created in this render (quickLog's existed=false); for an adopted entry show only '✓ Logged · Tag reason' (opening the editor, whose Delete has the Undo toast). If a remove stays, route it through the same toast-with-restore as the dialog's Delete.

title: Auto-log quiz misses re-creates entries on every redraw: Undo does not stick and a resolved miss comes back as a new open duplicate
detail: With 'Auto-log quiz misses' on, answer a CS 4.2.1.2 quiz question wrong: one entry is logged (correct). (a) Tap the pill's Undo, go Home and back to the topic's Quiz tab: the picked-up attempt re-shows the answered question and a NEW entry is created (err_16vaze2nnh after the Undo). (b) Mark that entry resolved (hub or Drill), leave and come back the same day: a second, open entry with the same title is created (err_q0rnt02t03) beside the resolved one; openCount 1 → 2 and the rail count rises. Same for a finished attempt reopened (its last question is re-marked). Reproduced twice each.
rootCause: js/engines/quiz.js:251 calls marked() for every already-answered question when an attempt is picked up (show()), and marked() passes auto: getSetting('autoLogQuiz') (quiz.js:306); js/core/errorlog.js:176-179 then quickLogs whenever no OPEN entry has the dedupeKey, so a resolved or undone entry is logged again
evidence: eval sequence on Sample: Undo → Home → topic Quiz → items [exam-q, quiz open (new id)]; setStatus(resolved) → Home → topic Quiz → [resolved, open duplicate], openCount 2
fix: Auto-log only from answer() (a fresh answer), never from a replayed marked(): pass auto only when the answer was just given. Optionally remember an undone dedupeKey for the run.

title: Error Log titles captured from quizzes and exam questions show raw markup ($LaTeX$, `code`, **bold**) and often the wrong line ('Write a program for:', a data line)
detail: The capture builds an entry's title by stripping only HTML tags from the question's text before its first code fence; the hub, the Drill and the capture dialog print it as plain text. Measured over every quiz and exam item of CS, Maths and IT (5,240): 1,812 titles would carry raw $…$ LaTeX, 440 **bold**, 209 backticks, and 366 are under 25 characters because the real question sits after a code block ('Write a program for:', '**Figure 3:**', 'Hand-trace this algorithm with the inputs `4, 6, 3, 2, -1`:'). Example logged on Sample: CS 4.2.1.2 exam Q1 is titled "`Items = [12, 25, 12, 53]`." (the data line, with its backticks) while the question is 'Dry run the algorithm with a table of …'.
rootCause: js/engines/quiz.js:287 (quiz) and :667 (exam) take String(q).split(/\n\s*```/)[0] and strip only <tags>; js/modules/errorlog.js:732 (hub card h3) and :382 (Drill h2) render the title with text:, never KOS.content.inline + typeset
evidence: /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS-519/audit-evidence/2026-12/shots/study-core/errorlog-hub-mac-sample-1.png; eval over KOS.content.get(sid,ref) quiz+exam items of every leaf: {latex:1812,bold:440,tick:209,short:366}
fix: Render titles and context through KOS.content.inline (and typeset for Maths) in the hub, Drill and dialog; build the title from the question's asking sentence (the last prose paragraph when the stem opens with data or code) and keep the full stem in context.
phase1: U7/U8 Error Log; Neon study-cleanup (rich exam prompts)

title: '✓ Logged · Tag reason' (and every openCapture) does nothing when tapped before the Error Log bundle has loaded: it calls KOS.lazy.ensure, which does not exist
detail: openCapture() opens the capture/edit dialog at once only when page-errorlog is already in; otherwise it asks KOS.lazy.ensure([...]), which is not part of KOS.lazy (need/ready/pending/all/warm/on/...). So a tap before the warm-up has fetched the bundle is silently dropped and never opens later. Reproduced on Sample: reload, then within ~1 s call the pill's path KOS.errorLog.openCapture(entry): after 5 s KOS.errorLogUI had loaded (warm-up) but no dialog ever opened (dialog: false). On a fast local server the warm-up lands ~3 s after boot; with Save-Data (warm() returns early, lazy.js:291), a slow or offline-first start, or a bundle that failed to fetch, the button stays dead until #/errorlog is visited. The same call backs exams' 'lost marks → Log mistake' (examreview.js:134) and the Handwritten tab's capture (inktab.js:149).
rootCause: js/core/errorlog.js:166 — `if (KOS.lazy && KOS.lazy.ensure) KOS.lazy.ensure(["page-errorlog"], openNow)`; js/core/lazy.js exports need() (a promise), no ensure
evidence: eval right after reload: {hadUIAtTap:false, uiNow:true, dialog:false}; typeof KOS.lazy.ensure === 'undefined'
fix: KOS.lazy.need('page-errorlog').then(openNow) (as today.js:422 does for page-creatives), with a toast on failure; add a smoke that calls openCapture with the bundle unloaded (boot({lazy:true})).
phase1: U7/U8 Error Log; the 26 Nov move of the hub into page-errorlog

title: Quick Error Drill: the button's count ignores the hub's filters, and the Drill ignores type, source, status and search, so '(8)' opens 1 of 8 while 2 cards are shown
detail: On the hub, filter by mistake type 'Careless / slip' (2 cards listed): the button still reads '▶ Quick Error Drill (8)' and opens 'DRILL · 1 OF 8'. From #/errorlog/compsci/4.2.1.2 (2 cards) the button reads (8) but opens 1 OF 2 (subject+topic are honoured, the rest are not). The filters also never reach the address, so clearing the topic chip leaves #/errorlog/compsci/4.2.1.2 and a reload brings the filter back.
rootCause: js/modules/errorlog.js:510-516 — the header (built once in renderAll) counts openItems of all entries and passes only subject/topicRef; renderDrill (:330-333) filters by status 'open' + subject/topicRef only; paintList never calls KOS.router.replaceArg
evidence: eval: {filtered:2, btn:'▶ Quick Error Drill (8)', k2:'DRILL · 1 OF 8'}; cold #/errorlog/compsci/4.2.1.2 → 2 cards, button (8), drill 1 OF 2
fix: Count and drill the same set the list shows (pass the whole filter to the drill arg, or drill exactly the filtered open ids) and repaint the header count in paintList; mirror subject/topic into the route with replaceArg.

title: Quick Error Drill: Undo on 'Marked resolved' restarts the drill at card 1 and loses the run's resolved/revisited tally
detail: In the Drill, reveal card 1 of 8 and tap '✓ Got it' → 'DRILL · 2 OF 8' with a 'Marked resolved · Undo' toast. Tap Undo: the drill redraws from scratch at 'DRILL · 1 OF 8' (the undone card plus every card already done), and the end summary's counts restart at 0.
rootCause: js/modules/errorlog.js:431 — the toast's run does E().setStatus(cur.id, prevSt); KOS.rerender(), which remounts renderDrill with idx 0 and fresh counters (its state lives in the render closure, not KOS.view.memo, invariant 166)
evidence: /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS-519/audit-evidence/2026-12/shots/study-core/errorlog-drill-mac-sample.png; eval {a:'DRILL · 1 OF 8', b:'DRILL · 2 OF 8', afterUndo:'DRILL · 1 OF 8'}
fix: Keep idx/resolvedN/revisitedN in KOS.view.memo, and on Undo step back one card (idx--, resolvedN--) and repaint instead of rerendering.

title: Due today's 'Today so far · Reviewed' and Accuracy count quiz answers and exam self-marks as reviewed cards
detail: On Sample, rate a 17-card batch on CS 4.2.1.2 (17 distinct cards, 18 ratings) and answer two of its quiz questions (one right, one wrong). Review › Due today then reads 'Reviewed 19' and 'Accuracy 85%', while the batch said '17 reviewed', Card stats says 'Total reviews 18' and the session fallback above it computes 17. Every quiz answer and exam self-mark (keys q:/e:, src 'question'), redo item (x:) and Creatives theory card is counted, because the filter only excludes Code, Japanese and Mind keys. A student who does three 10-question quizzes and no flashcards sees 'Reviewed 30'.
rootCause: js/core/reviewlog.js:99 isCard() = not /^(code|ja|mind):/ — it lets q:, e:, x: rows through; js/modules/due.js:268 counts its distinct keys as 'Reviewed' and g>=3 as accuracy
evidence: /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS-519/audit-evidence/2026-12/shots/study-core/review-mac-sample-after17.png; eval: reviewLog.range(today) 20 rows, keys q:compsci:4.2.1.2:0 (g3) and :1 (g1) src 'question'; [data-ui~=review.today-n] '19', today-acc '85%'
fix: Make isCard exclude src 'question'/'redo' (or key prefixes q:, e:, x:), or count only keys in KOS.srs.curriculumCards + custom cards, as Card stats does with inScope.
phase1: 1A bk:study-core#1 (review counts from the review log)

title: The Sample account is built with no flashcard schedules: Due today, Card stats and every desk's Cards strip read empty (0 / 1,894)
detail: Since 1A the sample builder is its own lazy bundle and runs as soon as it arrives, before the curriculum bundles: KOS.srs.cardsFor() returns no cards then, so the ~40 studied topics' card records (sample.js:66-73) are never written. Rebuilt from scratch on slot 3 (sample localStorage + every -sample IndexedDB deleted, switched back to Sample): sampleSeeded true, 283 sessions (72 flashcard sessions claiming 1,468 cards), but state.srs has 0 keys, while KOS.srs.cardsFor('compsci','4.1.1.1') returns 15 a few seconds later. Result on Sample: Due today '0 cards due', Card stats 'No review history in this scope', the CS desk's Review strip '0 due · — recall · 0 / 1894', topic inspectors 'Cards scheduled 0 / 17' on topics marked studied — the demo account the audits judge 'full' cannot show a review queue.
rootCause: js/main.js:347-352 lazy.need('sample') then KOS.sample.ensure() with no wait for the content bundles; js/core/sample.js:67 KOS.srs.cardsFor(...) reads the not-yet-loaded curriculum (invariant 168: anything computed or saved must not miss). Introduced by 0c281eb7 (1A, 'the sample account leaves boot').
evidence: eval after rebuild: {seeded:true, srs:0, sessions:283, cardsNow:15}; /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS-519/audit-evidence/2026-12/shots/study-core/subject-compsci-mac-sample.png (Cards 0 / 1894)
fix: Load the curriculum bundles the builder reads before seeding (KOS.lazy.need(['sample', 'cs-content', 'maths-content', 'it-content']) or a needsFor list in sample.js), and repair an already-seeded Sample namespace that has sampleSeeded but no srs.

title: Cold start: the curriculum stand-ins are never installed, so the due queue is empty until the content bundles land — Review says 'Queue clear', Card stats 'No review history', Home ticks 'Clear the due flashcards'
detail: With 44 cards due (KOS.srs.dueCount() = 44 once the bundles are in), reload the app on #/review, #/review/due/all, #/review/stats or #/home and wait 9-10 s: Review shows '0 cards due · Queue clear', the review run 'Queue clear. Nothing is due', Card stats 'Cards in scope 123 · No review history in this scope', the Study rail has no due badge, and Home's Daily goal shows 'Clear the due flashcards' ticked and struck through. None of these pages redraws when the warm-up loads the bundles; only navigating away and back (or any rerender) shows the 44. Right after boot Object.keys(KOS_CONTENT) holds 52 keys (Japanese and Creatives only) — none of the 448 CS/Maths/IT/Code stand-ins of js/data/lazy-index.js — so KOS.srs.allCards()/dueCards() (built on Object.keys(KOS_CONTENT)) return nothing and KOS.lazy.needsFor('review') asks only for ['ink-ui'], never the content. Reproduced on Sample three times (#/review/due/all twice, #/review, #/review/stats, #/home). Every Home Screen relaunch of the PWA lands here. Pre-dates Phase 1 (same in f479433b).
rootCause: index.html:185 runs js/data/lazy-index.js (→ KOS.lazy.install) while the parser is still above the content templates (first content <template data-lazy> at index.html:352); js/core/lazy.js:211 install() takes `known = files()`, which querySelectorAll's only the templates parsed so far (lazy.js:62-76), so `if (!known[bundle]) return;` (lazy.js:218) skips every content row; reviewBundles (lazy.js:342-355) then finds no pend bundles to wait for (invariant 168)
evidence: /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS-519/audit-evidence/2026-12/shots/study-core/home-cold-mac-sample-44due.png; /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS-519/audit-evidence/2026-12/shots/study-core/review-run-resumed-mac-sample.png; eval 0.8 s after reload: {KOS_CONTENT keys: ja 28, creatives 24; dc:0; needsFor('review'): ['ink-ui']}; 9 s after reload on #/review: '0 cards due' while dueCount() = 44
fix: Install the stand-ins once the document is parsed (call install from DOMContentLoaded, or have files() not cache and install re-run for bundles that appear later), or move the lazy-index script below the last <template data-lazy>; add a browser-boot check (boot({lazy:true}) with the real index order) that KOS_CONTENT holds a stub for every index row before the first draw.

title: Topic inspector: once a quiz has a score, 'Quiz best' and its value run together on the left ('Quiz best25% →') instead of the value sitting right like every other row
detail: Finish a quiz on Maths S4.1 (3/12): the inspector row reads 'Quiz best25% →' hard against its label, while Card views, Quiz attempts, Recall today etc. right-align their value. Seen on mac (1470) and every width where the inspector shows.
rootCause: js/modules/topic.js:931-932 wraps the value in a ; css/views/study.css:409 pushes only a DIRECT `strong` right (`.k-insp-list strong { margin-inline-start: auto }`) and .k-insp-link (study.css:1368) has no auto margin, so the button stays beside the span

title: Quiz history on a phone spends four lines on each question: the ✗ marks, the % and 'today' each get a row of their own
detail: Open a quiz's History on iPhone (402) or Slide Over: each row is the question, then the marks on their own line, then the percentage alone at the right, then 'today' alone at the right — about 130 px a row, so twelve items fill five screens with mostly empty space. On the Mac the same row is one line.
rootCause: css/views/study.css:1458-1459 — the phone tier makes the grid `minmax(0,1fr) 7ch` and spans marks and when across the whole row; the percentage is auto-placed after the marks (a third row) instead of beside the question
fix: At that tier place .k-qz-hist-pct at grid-row 1 / column 2 and put marks and when together on row 2 (one flex line), so a row is two lines.

title: The same quiz miss logged from the topic and from Due's 'Questions back' makes two Error Log entries: the dedupe key uses the item's place in the mounted list, not its question key
detail: On Sample, miss 'Which is NOT a binomial condition?' in Maths S4.1's Quiz tab and tap '+ Log mistake': entry keyed quiz:maths:S4.1:1:…. The same question asked back by Due today is mounted alone, so its pill computes quiz:maths:S4.1:0:… — it shows '+ Log mistake' instead of '✓ Logged', and a tap adds a second open entry for the same question (state.errorLog.items: …:1:Which is NOT… and …:0:Which is NOT…). Two different questions of a topic asked back on the same day are only kept apart by the 48-character text slice.
rootCause: js/engines/quiz.js:300 dedupeKey = 'quiz:'+sid+':'+ref+':'+qi+':'+qPlain.slice(0,48), where qi is the index into the items passed to mountMCQ; js/modules/due.js:384 mounts [item] (qi always 0) although it passes the question's id as item.qk
evidence: eval: KOS.quiz.mountMCQ(h,'maths','S4.1',[items[1]],{bare:true,…}) → wrong → pill '+ Log mistake' → keys [quiz:maths:S4.1:1:Which is NOT…, quiz:maths:S4.1:0:Which is NOT…]
fix: Build the dedupeKey from the question's schedule key (qkeys[qi] / KOS.questions key 'q:sid:ref:id', which Due already supplies via item.qk) instead of the list position; same for the exam pill (quiz.js:676).

title: Due today › Questions back: after answering, the primary button reads 'See your score →' and does nothing; the working 'Next question →' sits below it
detail: Open Review › Questions back (Sample, Maths S4.1 items due), answer the first question: the card shows a crimson 'See your score → ↵' and, under the card, the run's own 'Next question →'. Clicking 'See your score' leaves the same question on screen ('Question 1 of 3' before and after, quiz.result still hidden). On the Mac at 832 px the real Next is at the fold's edge, so the only visible action is the dead one; Enter (its ↵ hint) is bound to it too.
rootCause: js/engines/quiz.js:229-232 always draws quiz.next ('See your score →' on the last of one item) and advance() (quiz.js:313-315) only scrolls to a result that a caller-owned run (own, opts.onFinish) never shows; opts.bare (due.js:384) hides the header but not this button
evidence: /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS-519/audit-evidence/2026-12/shots/study-core/review-questions-run-answered-mac-sample.png; eval {nextText:'See your score →↵', c1:'Question 1 of 3', after click c2:'Question 1 of 3', resultHidden:true}
fix: With opts.bare (or own), do not draw quiz.next; let the run's own 'Next question →' take the primary style and the Enter key.

title: Card stats › Due forecast on a phone: the 'over' and 'today' axis labels overprint ('overtoday')
detail: On iPhone (402) the first two forecast bars are labelled 'over' (x 66-89) and 'today' (x 82-112): 7 px of overlap, read as one word 'overtoday'. Fine on mac (294-317 / 324-355) and iPad portrait (150-173 / 188-219).
rootCause: js/modules/cardstats.js:265-269 labels two adjacent narrow bars (overdue, then today) with words; barChart gives each label only its bar's width
evidence: /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS-519/audit-evidence/2026-12/shots/study-core/cardstats-iphone-sample.png; label rects at iphone over:66-89, today:82-112
